whenToUse: Content deleted by mistake must be recovered.
People need to know who changed what and when.
whenNotToUse: Undoing only the last action is enough (use undo).
Restoring would delete the later versions.
You wouldn't say what changed in each version.
accessibility: The version list is radio buttons grouped with fieldset and legend.
The current version is marked with a badge in text.
The restore result is read with role="status".
